decision_rationale: The paper presents dnaGrinder as a genomic foundation model, pretrained on multispecies and human genomes with fine-tuning on downstream tasks. However, the full text explicitly describes it as an "encoder-based model," so it is not a genuinely generative architecture.
evidence_snippet: "our use of sequence length warmup is the first implementation of this technique in an encoder-based model"; "We trained the dnaGrinder model on reference genomes of multispecies and human genomes"; "superior or comparable performance on several genomic applications"
